pairs.why: A keeps the real feeder's chunky slab roof, solid gable wall and two-strand rope, while B turns it into a spindly open frame with thin posts and braces plus an added metal hanger.
A's locker is squat with stubby feet like the real one; B's legs are longer and its body is slimmer, but both have similar slab doors and tight corners.
The real calculator is a flat slab with tight bevelled corners, which B matches, while A's body is a swollen pillow with big soft blob corners and a rounded top.
A has big simple sails and a chunky hull like the real card, while B breaks the rigging into many thin ladders and small tiers.
A's crown is low and flat and the band is slim like the real cap, while B has a tall bulky crown, an oversized badge and a thick band and visor.
B has the real anchor's thick shank and stock, while A's stock is a thin bar with small balls.
A has a thick slab top and short stout stools like the real card, while B's stools are taller and waisted with ring mouldings.
B has the real calculator's flat slab body with tight corners, while A's body is a fat rounded blob with soft corners.
